purpose: Expand reviewed physical mask/headgear topology across protective gear, anthropomorphic species-face assemblies, ceremonial masks, and superhero identity cowls while keeping source-appearance translation pending.

systemic_findings: Physical mask topology should carry a semantic-function label so identical component relationships can be separated into protective, ceremonial, species-identity, and superhero-identity uses.
Standard cylindrical printed heads can legitimately combine with strong silhouette-bearing mask geometry; they should not be mistaken for modified heads.
Multi-layer assemblies should preserve independent mask, hair/headdress, and underlying-head channels for training and reconstruction.
